title: Identify the Model Change
text: Unregularized OLS with an added feature is a nested model: the old solution is still available by setting the new coefficient to $$0$$.

title: Classify the Change
text: Does this change generally make the model more flexible, less flexible, or more regularized?

title: Connect to the Measure
text: Since the model can keep the old fit or improve it, training MSE can decrease.
